# x402 Scraper API

> Autonomous, framework-agnostic web scraper powered by x402 HTTP micropayments across Solana and Base EVM.

## Overview
- **Base URL:** https://x402-scraper-api-production-67a4.up.railway.app
- **Protocol:** x402 V2 (HTTP 402 Payment Required + Base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header)
- **Supported Chains:** Solana (SPL-USDC) & Base (EVM USDC)
- **Pricing:** $0.01 USDC per request

## Endpoints
- **POST /mcp** - JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint for scraping tools (e.g., `scrape_basic`).

## Quick Integration (Solana)
```javascript
import X402ScraperSolanaTool from "./solana-tool-wrapper.js";
const tool = new X402ScraperSolanaTool();
const result = await tool.invoke("https://example.com");
```

## Quick Integration (Base)
```javascript
import X402ScraperBaseTool from "./base-tool-wrapper.js";
const tool = new X402ScraperBaseTool();
const result = await tool.invoke("https://example.com");
```
